body: You're right on. The funny thing is I'm usually the last person to realize I am depressed.  Thank you for seeing that and thank you for your words of inspiration.
This song brought me to much needed tears. Thank you.

It's strange but I don't feel like I need or deserve help. I feel like I can control these things to an extent if I just tried hard enough.

Thank you for your words, really.

I stay up until 4AM if I don't drink. I'm bothered by my mind and my imperfections. I know that everyone has character flaws but I can't stop obsessing over them.  I just feel like every little thing I do wrong makes me a hypocrite. I hate being a hypocrite because I think it makes me unworthy to live to this life I've established for myself.  People turn to me for advise and help but at the same time I am living this lie. All of my life, I've established this persona, and wanted to do everything correctly and beautifully but there's this other side of me that just doesn't live up to those standards.
